title: “I Searched for a Religious Song in Amharic and Got Sexual Content Instead”: Investigating Online Harm in Low-Resourced Languages on YouTube.
reasoning: The paper is an empirical HCI study focused on online harm and moderation failures in low-resourced languages. While it uses religious searches as a primary example of benign user behavior leading to harmful results and discusses cultural/religious values in user feedback, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, theology, or ethics themselves.
